title: Chain-held stop check, live on Somnia Tokyo testnet (2026-10-29)
note: Owner-side steps (arming the TP/SL bracket, resting an order, cancelling) were sent by the account owner with the dreamDEX SDK, as a trader does in the app. The bot only read them and answered in Telegram; the quotes are the bot's messages, copied as sent.

steps.what: /long XRP 2.4 5x tp 1% sl 1%: opened 9.1 XRP long (bot-side TP/SL 1% away)
Armed a linked dreamDEX TP/SL bracket on the chain: TP 1.3363, SL 1.2968, whole position (0.15 STT locked per stop)

steps.quote:
✅ TP 1.3363 (market, whole position) · 1.48% from the mark: OK, closes 9.1 XRP when it fires
✅ SL 1.2968 (market, whole position) · 1.52% from the mark: OK, closes 9.1 XRP when it fires

steps.what: Rested a post-only sell of 7 XRP 20% above the market (it cannot fill soon). Pool capacity read: position 9.1, pending sells 7, effective reducing capacity 2.1 XRP; the pool minimum is 6.9 XRP

steps.quote: ⚠️ SL 1.2968 (market, whole position) · 1.48% from the mark: will close NOTHING when it fires. Your resting sell orders on XRP-PERP (7 XRP) use up the position's closing capacity, so the stop is dropped (ReduceOnlyBelowMinQty) and its fee is spent. Cancel those orders to restore it

steps.what: Unprompted alert, 56 s after the resting order (the stop-health pass runs every minute)
steps.quote:
⚠️ Stop health · XRP-PERP
SL 1.2968 (market, whole position) · 1.53% from the mark: will close NOTHING when it fires. ...

steps.what: Cancelled the resting sell; capacity back to 9.1 XRP

steps.quote:
chain-held: TP 1.3363 ✅ · SL 1.2968 ✅
bot-side: TP 1.3315 SL 1.3051

steps.what: Unprompted alert: the bracket outlived its position
steps.quote:
⚠️ Stop health · XRP-PERP
TP 1.3363 (market, whole position): no open XRP-PERP position, so it places nothing if it fires and still spends its STT fee.
